name: Tourism Enterprises Co.
summary: Tourism Enterprises Co. specializes in overseeing a variety of commercial and hospitality properties across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The firm's extensive management portfolio encompasses facilities such as vacation chalets, motels, hotels, recreational parks, dining establishments, urban developments, play areas, aquatic centers, rest stops, and central service hubs, in addition to other related offerings. A key asset under its direct ownership and operation is the Palm Beach Resort. The company was established in 1991 and maintains its primary base of operations in Dammam, Saudi Arabia.
